query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN supplierId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sem_fornecedor,
       SUM(CASE WHEN supplierId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as com_fornecedor
FROM expenses WHERE status != 'CANCELADA'
